conventions.rule: A feature becomes 'passing' only after its verify ran and was observed to pass. Never edit or weaken a verify to make a feature pass.
conventions.verify_kind: 'command' = verify is a shell command; scripts/features-verify.ps1 runs it and a 'passing' status must match its result. 'manual' = an end-to-end check a person or browser performs; evidence is a screenshot or recorded output.
conventions.traces: Each feature traces to spec R-IDs in docs/sdlc/bulk-link/spec.md.
conventions.tracker: Optional. The issue key or URL.
